about: A made-up net for rehearsing Sidekick's two speeds (python -m tools.sidekick_replay --script docs/sidekick/rehearsal.json --deep). Calls are unassigned in the FCC database; the place is fictional.

rows.text: Good evening, this is K7QXN, net control for the Springfield Evening Net. We'll now take check-ins from any station, anywhere. Please call now.
W9QXJ, Dana in Springfield, no traffic.
W9QXJ, thanks Dana. Next station, please.
Any further check-ins? Nothing heard. Moving on to the topic of the evening.
Sidekick, this is W9QXJ. Can you tell us which amateur bands a General class licensee may use for voice on HF, and roughly where the phone segments are? Over.
While that's being looked up, let's talk about antenna maintenance before winter. Check your coax connectors for water.
Good point, I found green corrosion on one of mine last spring.
Any comments or questions for the net before we close?
Sidekick, go ahead with your response.
Thank you. This is K7QXN closing the Springfield Evening Net. 73 to all.
